title: Company and Legal Information
summary: Art of Menu is a software product owned by Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. This page sets out the Company's identification, contact and tax details and the legal documents relating to Art of Menu.

head: Item
Details
rows: Art of Menu (the trade name of the software product owned by the Company)
Pınarbaşı Mah. Hürriyet Cad. Akdeniz Üniversitesi Uluğbey Ar-Ge 2 No: 3 A İç Kapı No: B103 Konyaaltı / Antalya, Türkiye

blocks.p: The Company's principal business activity is computer programming (activity code 621000). Under the name Art of Menu, the Company provides restaurants, cafés and similar businesses with digital QR menu and order management software on a subscription basis. The Company is not the seller of the products that businesses sell to their guests.
Art of Menu subscriptions are sold directly by the Company to businesses in Türkiye and in other countries. The Company is the provider and seller of the service.
Art of Menu's primary data is hosted on server infrastructure managed by the Company.
The Company has no company, branch, office or representative outside Türkiye.
You can send the Company requests concerning your rights under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where applicable, the GDPR by the following means:

ul: by e-mail to [hello@goktigin.com](mailto:hello@goktigin.com) from the e-mail address registered in the Company's systems;
by a written application bearing your wet-ink signature sent to the registered address above.

blocks.p: If you are a guest of a business, requests concerning the data the business holds about you must be made to the business, which is the data controller. If such requests reach the Company, the Company forwards them to the business concerned.
